subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this timing fix as sufficient for the missing-tool-result race?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the user-visible failure is a production channel/session-state path and the external PR evidence is still mock/test-only.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or equivalent live output showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source/test proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source inspection and focused regression tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the tracker
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101850 until a maintainer or contributor can produce stronger runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or equivalent live output showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.
